description: Retrieves patient health records and verifies declared medical procedures via the Aarogya Digital Health platform, operating under the National Digital Health Mission (NDHM) framework. Used in healthcare lending to verify that a loan applicant's declared medical procedure is recorded in their ABHA-linked health record and that the procedure cost estimate aligns with the requested loan amount. Requires explicit patient consent via an ABHA-linked OAuth consent token. Health data must not be persisted beyond the underwriting decision.
use_cases: Medical loan underwriting — verify declared procedure against ABHA health record
Cross-verifying hospital quote against NDHM procedure cost estimate
Confirming empanelled hospital registration for healthcare loan eligibility
Detecting inflated loan amounts by comparing against procedure cost estimate
Health record-based identity verification for medical finance
Routing unverifiable health claims to manual medical review
compliance_context: National Digital Health Mission (NDHM) framework. Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act). Explicit ABHA-linked patient consent required with timestamp and IP. Health record data must be purged within 24 hours of underwriting decision. Aadhaar must be masked in all logs.
typical_callers: Healthcare NBFCs, medical lending platforms, health insurance underwriters, hospital finance arms offering procedure-based loans
auth_description: OAuth2 Authorization Code flow. ABHA-linked patient consent token required. Session-scoped — must not persist beyond the current loan application session.
onboarding_note: ⚠️ This adapter requires custom onboarding approval before use.

versions.release_notes: Initial release; limited procedure verification; no cost estimate field
Added procedure cost estimate; improved ABHA consent flow; NDHM compliant

required_fields.description: 14-digit Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number — patient's National Digital Health ID
12-digit Aadhaar linked to the ABHA account; must be masked in all storage contexts
Patient full legal name as per Aadhaar for record matching
Medical procedure declared by the loan applicant (e.g. knee replacement, IVF, cardiac bypass)
Registration number of the empanelled hospital declaring the procedure
Loan amount in INR to cross-verify against procedure cost estimate
ABHA-linked OAuth consent token; session-scoped; must not persist beyond underwriting

optional_fields.description: Hospital-quoted procedure cost for cross-verification with Aarogya estimate
IP address of applicant device at consent time

abha_record_found.description: Health record found for ABHA number

cost_variance_flag.description: True if loan amount vs cost estimate exceeds threshold

manual_review_required.description: True if record absent or unverifiable

error_codes.400: Validation failed — check ABHA number format.
error_codes.403: Consent not granted or insufficient scope.
error_codes.404: No ABHA-linked record found — route to Manual Review.
error_codes.422: Procedure unverifiable — route to Manual Review.
error_codes.500: Aarogya internal error — retry once then Manual Review.

retry_policy.fallback_on_retry_exhaustion: Route to Manual Medical Review queue

data_retention_policy.health_record_data: Purge within 24 hours of underwriting decision
data_retention_policy.consent_token: Session-scoped; must not persist beyond application
data_retention_policy.storage_classification: Sensitive health data under DPDP Act 2023
data_retention_policy.aadhaar_masking: Mask in all logs and audit records

fallback_behaviour: Manual Medical Review queue — no automated fallback
